item.title: Pure Foods Tasmania Reports 71% Increase in Easter Sales, Signs Initial Supply Deal with Costco
item.description: Pure Foods Tasmania (ASX: PFT) logs a 71% rise in Easter orders, signs Costco supply deal; Coles expansion to 700 stores could lift annual revenue by ~$600k.

item.title: Where are the New Copper Discoveries? Deficit Remains, Small Caps to Benefit?
item.description: Copper faces a structural deficit through 2026 as demand from renewables and AI surges, boosting ASX-listed miners with new long-life supply.

item.title: Impact Minerals Identifies Multiple MT Conductors at Broken Hill
item.description: Impact Minerals uncovers multiple near-surface MT conductors at Broken Hill, hinting at a crustal-scale mineral system and potential deep-fluid pathways.

item.title: Earnings Season Growth Leaders: Gold, Copper, Industrials and More
item.description: Earnings season shifts to a stock-pickers market as the RBA lifts rates to 3.85%; focus on cash flow and balance sheets, with Macquarie leading earnings.

item.title: Bubs Australia Boosts FY26 Outlook on Strong US Growth
item.description: Bubs Australia lifts FY26 outlook on robust US growth, guiding $120-125M revenue and $4-6M EBITDA as US revenue jumps 48% to $34.2M.

item.title: Clean Teq Water Boosts European Expansion with Nyrstar Contract
item.description: Clean TeQ Water wins €5.06m Nyrstar contract in Belgium, accelerating European expansion as it moves from design to full-scale DESALX delivery on MBIX.

item.title: Lunnon Metals Commences Mining at Lady Herial as Resource Jumps 49%
item.description: Lunnon Metals lifts Lady Herial MRE 49% to 54,200 oz as mining starts; ore to SIGM's Lefroy plant under OPA, signaling near-term cash flow.

item.title: Metro Mining Posts Record Profit in 2025 on Strong Shipments
item.description: Metro Mining hits record FY2025 profit of AU$142.3m on 6.2Mt shipments; plans up to 5% on-market buy-back as EBITDA soars and debt falls.

item.title: Investigator Resources Unveils Maiden Reserve and Positive Economics for Paris Project
item.description: Investigator Resources unveils maiden Paris Silver Project reserve of 33 Moz; DFS shows 12 Mt @88 g/t with IRR 93%, NPV8 A$1.15b, A$260m funding looming.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: A record close and 3.7% month a big thumbs up
item.description: ASX 200 finishes at record close, up 3.7% in Feb as BHP profits beat and banks top forecasts; Block rockets on staff cuts; rare-earths rally lifts Lynas/Iluka.
